Home / Solutions / All on X Solutions / Temporary Restorations

Immediate Function. Controlled Outcomes.

Temporary restorations designed to support immediate function to dental implants, tissue development, and predictable transitions from surgery to final restoration.

Temporary restorations are more than a provisional phase. They help maintain function, support healing, validate restorative design, and create continuity between implant placement and definitive prosthetic delivery.

Plan My Immediate Load Case Request Chairside Support

Why Temporary
Restorations Matter

A Critical Phase of Full-Arch Treatment

For clinicians performing edentulous implant treatment, temporary restorations create an opportunity to establish:

  • Functional occlusion
  • Esthetic validation
  • Soft tissue development
  • Restorative verification for final restoration

Rather than serving as placeholders, provisional restorations become an active part of treatment and help prepare patients for long-term restorative success.

Two Pathways, One System

Temporary Restoration Pathways

Prefabricated Temporaries (GFMR)

Guided full mouth Restoration

Stackable pickup restorations, designed before surgery and delivered immediately following implant placement

Designed to Deliver

  • Same-day fixed restorations for immediate function
  • Restoratively driven workflows to reduce
    chairside adjustments

Best For

  • Guided surgery for accurate implant placement
  • Same-day treatment protocols for full-arch rehabilitation

Chairside Support Available

  • Temporary restoration pickup
  • Restoration refinement and finishing
  • Coordination to avoid hiccups during surgery

Post-Fabricated Temporaries (GFMP & FMP)

Guided Full Mouth Photogrammetry & Full mouth Photogrammetry

Screw-retained restorations, fabricated after surgery and implant placement using verified implant position capture. This works for guided or freehand surgeries.

Supported Technologies

  • Photogrammetry systems
  • Grammetry workflows

Designed to Deliver

  • Micron-level accuracy for passive provisional fit
  • Restorative flexibility, for freehand or guided surgery
  • Predictable progression toward final restorations

Chairside Photogrammetry Support Available

  • Helping clinicians to capture verified implant positions, accelerating provisionalization.

Key Benefits

Why Clinicians Choose 3DDX Temporary Restorations

Flexible Provisionalization Pathways

Choose the provisional workflow that best fits your clinical protocol, from same-day delivery to staged restorations.

Compatible with Guided and Freehand Workflows

Designed to integrate seamlessly with GFMR, GFMP, and conventional FMP treatment workflows.

Fast Turnaround Times

Receive provisional restorations within hours or a few days, depending on your selected workflow.

Immediate Function and Esthetics

Provide patients with functional, natural-looking provisional restorations during the healing phase.

Reduced Workflow Disruption

Maintain a smooth transition from surgery to definitive restoration with coordinated digital workflows.

Optimized Occlusion and Tissue Development

Support soft tissue shaping and occlusal stability using clear duplicates or photogrammetry technology to create a predictable foundation for the final restoration.
